title: Purpose Foundation on launch day — Eric the 'collector of obscure alternative governance systems'
summary: Purpose Foundation — the steward-ownership network behind Patagonia's ownership transition and dozens of mission-locked companies — posts a launch-day endorsement built around Eric's account of how Incorruptible began as a hobby collection.
blockquote: Some people collect butterfly wings, some people collect baseball cards. I collected obscure alternative governance systems and setups for companies. And I was just shocked how many of them there are, when I was taught that there was only one.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries, quoted by Purpose Foundation on LinkedIn
attribution_title: Steward-ownership network (Patagonia, Bosch, Sharetribe et al.)
